cues: Those are his books: aren't they.
We have to pay today: have to behaves like a full verb, so don't we.
You had better rest: hadn't you; you would rather walk: wouldn't you.
He used to smoke: didn't he.
He must be ill is a deduction whose real verb is be, so isn't he.
She hardly ever complains: hardly makes it negative, so does she.
With I think, the tag follows the inside clause: I think he is honest, isn't he.
